functional_source_assessment.summary: The four changed source paths implement the approved bounded command-input contract. Python launch admission uses the resolved running interpreter identity and requires isolated plus no-site startup before one directly pinned regular script. Bash admission requires the resolved system Bash with -p and one directly pinned regular script. Unsupported source forms are refused before journal mutation; all child processes receive DEVNULL stdin. Driver argument binding remains exact. Journal bounds, short-write handling, deadlines, process-group cleanup, and postcondition pin checks are present and covered by the affected suite.
functional_source_assessment.scope_limitations: The approved OS interpreter, standard library, Bash, readlink, and opaque pinned binaries remain trusted runtime inputs. The guard does not discover or pin arbitrary dependencies, semantically inspect opaque binaries, or provide a sandbox or process containment. These limits are documented in docs/process/task-run-guard.md.
